title: Senior Account Manager — Career at admepro | Cairo
desc: admepro is hiring a Senior Account Manager. Lead strategic client relationships at our AI-powered agency in Cairo — drive results and grow brands.
content: H2: Senior Account Manager
H3: Overview:

P: A Senior Account Manager is an experienced professional responsible for managing key client accounts and leading strategic initiatives. They typically have a deeper level of expertise and are expected to handle larger accounts or more complex client relationships.
H3: Job Description:
LI: Strategic Relationship Management : Cultivate and maintain long-term relationships with key clients, ensuring high levels of satisfaction and loyalty.
LI: Account Growth : Identify and pursue opportunities for account growth and expansion, including upselling and cross-selling services.
LI: Team Leadership : Lead and mentor junior account managers and support staff, fostering a collaborative team environment.
LI: Project Oversight : Ensure the successful delivery of projects by coordinating with internal teams, managing timelines, and mitigating risks.
LI: Client Strategy Development : Develop tailored strategies for clients that align with their business goals and industry trends.
LI: Financial Management : Monitor account profitability and ensure alignment with budgetary targets, managing pricing and contract negotiations.
LI: Reporting and Analysis : Provide detailed performance reports and insights to clients, demonstrating value and impact.
LI: Market Insights : Stay updated on industry developments, competitor actions, and market trends to provide strategic recommendations to clients.
H3: Requirements:
LI: Experience : 3-5 years in account management or client services within an agency.
LI: Education : Bachelor’s degree in business, marketing, or a related field.
LI: English Fluency : Essential for effective communication with clients and teams.
LI: Communication Skills : Strong verbal and written skills; ability to present ideas and negotiate effectively.
